rubric.item: Opens with one question for the merchant's stable identifier because no session merchant is given and the workspace holds more than one
rubric.note: A one-sentence reason (more than one merchant in the workspace), then a single question asking for the stable identifier.

rubric.item: No candidate listed or hinted at (no identifier, brand name or directory name)
rubric.note: Says only that there is more than one merchant. The examples 'merchant ID or fixed short name' are generic formats, not candidates.

rubric.item: Nothing merchant-specific follows the question (no title draft, brand wording, market/language assumption, HOOK-01 lookup)
rubric.note: Only promises to look up HOOK-01 after the user answers. No draft, no market assumption, and 0 tool calls.

rubric.item: Neither preference file read or changed; nothing written inside the installed package; Chinese
rubric.note: Only a count of the merchant directories was taken. No files were read or written, and the answer is in Chinese.

agent_unsure: Whether to give an example format (merchant ID or short name) when asking for the stable identifier; it gave a generic one.
